description: Change the starting cargo capacity to 10.
steps: Find the player/ship initial state or balance configuration that controls starting cargo capacity.
Set the starting cargo capacity to 10 without changing cargo upgrade increments unless required by tests or gameplay consistency.
Update HUD/default labels or persistence/reset behavior if they assume the old starting capacity.
acceptance: A new game starts with cargo capacity 10.
The cargo HUD displays 0/10 at game start.
Existing cargo upgrades and saved-game reset behavior still work correctly.
